library(weather)

# The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
client <- WeatherClient(client_config(
  endpoint = Sys.getenv("WEATHER_ENDPOINT"),
  token = function() Sys.getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN")
))

# Values from the model's example "Read a city".
input <- GetCityInput(
  city_id = "c-0a1b2c3d",
  # 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
  at = timestamp(1767323045)
)

tryCatch(
  {
    output <- client$get_city(input)
    print(output$city)
    print(output$forecast)
    print(output$request_id)
  },
  NotFoundError = function(error) {
    message("NotFoundError (HTTP ", error$metadata$status, "): ", conditionMessage(error))
  }
)

client$close()
